packs: strings

=== str-len
(str-len "abc")
--- want
3

=== str-len counts runes
(str-len "héllo")
--- want
5

=== str-len empty
(str-len "")
--- want
0

=== str-concat
(str-concat "a" "b" "c")
--- want
"abc"

=== str-concat needs strings
(str-concat "a" 1)
--- error

=== str-join
(str-join "-" (list "a" "b"))
--- want
"a-b"

=== str-join empty list
(str-join "-" (list))
--- want
""

=== str-split
(str-split "," "a,b")
--- want
(list "a" "b")

=== str-split no separator present
(str-split "," "abc")
--- want
(list "abc")

=== str-find present
(str-find "foo" "foobar")
--- want
#t

=== str-find absent
(str-find "baz" "foobar")
--- want
#f

=== str-sub
(str-sub "héllo" 1 3)
--- want
"él"

=== str-sub to end
(str-sub "hello" 3)
--- want
"lo"

=== str-replace
(str-replace "l" "L" "hello")
--- want
"heLLo"

=== str-trim
(str-trim "  hi  ")
--- want
"hi"

=== str-upper
(str-upper "abc")
--- want
"ABC"

=== str-lower
(str-lower "ABC")
--- want
"abc"

=== str-fmt string
(str-fmt "%s!" "hi")
--- want
"hi!"

=== str-fmt float
(str-fmt "%.2f" 3.14159)
--- want
"3.14"

=== str-fmt %d
(str-fmt "%d" 1)
--- want
"1"

=== str-fmt %d with width
(str-fmt "[%3d]" 7)
--- want
"[  7]"

=== str-fmt %d zero padded
(str-fmt "%03d" 7)
--- want
"007"

=== str-fmt %d rejects a fraction
(str-fmt "%d" 1.5)
--- error

=== str-fmt %d rejects a string
(str-fmt "%d" "1")
--- error

=== str-fmt %s renders any value as text
(str-fmt "%s %s %s" 42 #t "x")
--- want
"42 #t x"

=== str-fmt %v renders a Filo literal
(str-fmt "%v" (list 1 "a"))
--- want
"(list 1 \"a\")"

=== str-fmt left-aligned width
(str-fmt "[%-4s]" "ab")
--- want
"[ab  ]"

=== str-fmt percent sign
(str-fmt "100%%")
--- want
"100%"

=== str-fmt unknown verb is an error
(str-fmt "%x" 1)
--- error

=== str-fmt incomplete verb is an error
(str-fmt "50%")
--- error

=== str-fmt missing argument is an error
(str-fmt "%s %s" "a")
--- error

=== str-fmt extra argument is an error
(str-fmt "%s" "a" "b")
--- error

=== str-fmt format must be a string
(str-fmt 1)
--- error
